fact: The DigiCare Cameroon project (launched 23 November 2023, University of Buea and Ngaoundere) will establish health information systems at three pilot health centres to feed machine learning disease prediction and build NLP chatbots and dashboards of national health statistics; the article describes it as a plan, with no AI yet reported in service.
title: Leveraging AI in digital one health: an inter-university collaboration for emerging and re-emerging infectious disease control in Cameroon
